Grocery shopping at the local shops, comparing prices and paying in cash within the weekly budget
Cooking and eating a simple flexitarian lunch of rice, lentils and vegetables, then wiping the bench and labelling leftovers
Tidying the room and laying out comfortable clothes and closed shoes for volunteering
Travelling by train and bus to the animal shelter for the afternoon volunteering shift
Volunteering at the animal shelter, feeding and walking rescue dogs and cleaning kennels
Travelling home on public transport from the animal shelter
Taking a shower and putting a load of laundry into the washing machine
Cooking a flexitarian dinner of stir-fried tofu and vegetables with rice in the rice cooker
Eating dinner and drinking tea while checking the phone for any written updates about tomorrow's shift roster
Washing up dishes, drying them, and wiping down the shared benches and stove area
Writing a clear text-only message with a house meeting agenda and confirming plan details in advance, then looking at the photo of the family dog
Making a final herbal tea and refilling the kettle for the morning
Working on a social work assignment on the computer with the desk lamp on, saving drafts in short timed blocks
